commit.message: feat(door): AUTO_WITH_DECORRELATED_REVIEW — tier policy, guard, honest token

intent: PR-A of the walking-mode loop-closure plan: implement the operator ruling of 2026-07-29 (DOOR = AUTO_WITH_DECORRELATED_REVIEW). Frozen tier policy file; required tier-policy guard (tier-2 structural freeze, diff ceilings, decorrelated review quorum, test-deletion sign-off, 20/day rate limit, canary hard-fail); rename the CI-synthesized confirmation token merge-pr-N to automerge-policy-pass-N at every site; verbatim ruling record in docs/ops/. This PR grants automation its merge policy, therefore automation can never merge it: operator hand-merge only.

negative_controls.command: python3 -c "import json,subprocess,sys; from pathlib import Path; p=Path('scripts/governance/automerge_tier_policy.json'); orig=p.read_text(); d=json.loads(orig); d['tiers']['tier2']['paths']=[]; p.write_text(json.dumps(d)); r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-m','pytest','tests/test_automerge_tier_policy.py','-q'],check=False); p.write_text(orig); sys.exit(0 if r.returncode!=0 else 2)"
negative_controls.name: emptying-tier2-paths-breaks-contract-test

honest_blockers: Structural enforcement completes only with two operator actions after hand-merge: add the 'Automerge tier policy' context to branch protection, and land the matching ci_parity_manifest.json row via the titanium track (that file is titanium-owned and deliberately untouched here).

Decorrelated review v1 counts native APPROVED reviews from policy reviewer families on the head SHA; the full structured-verdict schema (checked-items + re-run receipts) is a named next step in the ruling record.
Tier-0 third-model tiebreak and auto-draft-conversion on tier-1 disagreement are not automated; the guard fails red instead (fail-closed superset), with watcher automation landing in PR-F.
Makefile:264 help text still shows the old token; Makefile is titanium-owned and excluded from this packet — one-line follow-up under that track.
session_entry.rollback: Revert the single commit: the guard workflow, policy file, and ruling record disappear and the confirmation token returns to merge-pr-N. No branch-protection state is touched by the revert.
